spec.name: A
spec.query: ( sum by (pod, namespace, container) ( rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="POD",container!="",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"}[5m]) * on(pod, namespace) group_left() kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name="audit-service-v2",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) / sum by (pod, namespace, container) ( kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left() kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name="audit-service-v2",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) )

annotations.resolution: CPU near limit/throttling. kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} top pods; check SigNoz; scale replicas or raise the CPU limit.
annotations.summary: audit pod {{ $labels.pod }} CPU at {{ printf "%.2f" $value }} of limit
